༄༅/ /gnod sbyin 'khor lo'i cho ga la brten nas gter bum sgrub pa'i man ngag 'dod rgu'i bum bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// gnod sbyin 'khor lo'i cho ga la brten nas gter bum sgrub pa'i man ngag 'dod rgu'i bum bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

oṃ swasti/ gang zhig bsnyen pas 'dod rgu'i dpal// yid bzhin sbyin mdzad bla ma lhar// btud nas phun tshogs gter chen po'i// bum bzang sgrub pa'i man ngag 'bri// 'di la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ sgrub pa po rdor phreng nang gi nor rgyun ma'i dkyil 'khor du dbang thob pa'am/ ma thob kyang rigs gsum spyi'am/ a ra pa tsa na lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor du dbang thob pa/ 'di nyid kyi 'khor lo la brten pa'i rjes gnang ngam/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho nas 'byung ba'i rjes gnang legs par thob cing*/ dam tshig dang sdom pa rnam par dag pas sngon du bsnyen pa rgyas bsdus gang rigs dang*/ 'khor lo sgrub pa sogs ji skad bshad pa bzhin tshags su tshud par byas nas lag len dngos ni/ rin po che'am rdza'i bum pa gas chag med pa'i nang du ke tshe dang bra bo ma gtogs pa'i 'bru sna tshogs/ ra gan zha nye mkhar ba ma gtogs pa'i rin po che sna tshogs/ dug rigs dang gla rtsi ma gtogs pa'i sman sna tshogs/ sha chang sgog rigs ma gtogs pa'i zas sna tshogs/ dar sna/ gos sna/ snam ras rnams rgyal khab phyug po'i lag nas byung ba rab/ min yang bkra shis pa'i gang zag las rnyed pa dang*/ gzhan yang gnas dang gang zag byin rlabs can dang*/ bsod nams can dang dpal g.yang can gyi khang sa zhing sa rta phyugs kyi spu sogs dge ba'i rdzas ci 'byor pa blugs/ khyad par rje btsun rin po ches 'khor lo'i man ngag las/ za ma tog chen po'i nang du bzhag la/ mar dang sbrang rtsi dang sha kha ras nub par byas te/ dus rgyun du me tog la sogs pas mchod pa byas na dngos grub thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs pa ltar zhun mar dang sbrang rtsi ka ra rnams kyis gtams/ bum pa'i stod kyi char 'khor lo rab gnas can steng 'og dang mdun rgyab ma nor bar na bza' ser po dang bcas te gzhug /slar yang 'bru sna dang sman sna bsres pas 'thas par dgang*/

spro na skabs rnams su bkra shis rtags brgyad/ rdzas brgyad/ rin chen sna bdun/ 'dod yon nyer spyod bcas bris pa'am 'jim pa la spar btab pa'ang gzhug /kha spra tshil lam 'jim pa gtsang mas srubs med par bkag /mgrin pa yan chad ras gtsang mas dkris la mdun du bkra shis rtags brgyad dam nor bu bri/ de lta bu'i bum pa du yod gzhi gtsang mar padma 'dab brgyad re bris pa'i steng du bzhag /mthar mchod pa dang gtor ma bsham/ gzungs thag ser po gdags/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ skyabs 'gro nas gzung bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar sngon du 'gro bas/ bum pa bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bum pa'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i paṃ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du rin po che dang*/ 'bru bcud dang*/ zas nor longs spyod lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pas yongs su gang bar gyur/ ces dang*/ rgyas par spro na tshig lhug rnams mi dgos par sngags drug phyag drug tsam spyi ltar dang*/ mi nus na nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang bcas/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo sogs nas/ i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis/ yo byad thams cad 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga'i rang bzhin dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba zad mi shes pa'i gter du gyur par bsam/ de lta bu'i bum pa'i stod kyi char paṃ las padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du baṃ dang 'bras kyi snye ma las nor rgyun mar gsal ba'i brla g.yon pa'i steng du dzaṃ dang bī dza pū ra ka las dzambha la dang*/ 'khor rnams skad cig gis/ shar du zla 'od ma dang nor bu bzang po/ lhor sbyin ma dang gang ba bzang po/ nub tu rab tu sbyin ma dang nor sbyin/ byang du 'phags ma dang rnam thos sras/ shar lhor rab tu bzang mo dang rol pa'i phreng ba/

lho nub tu sbas ma dang 'jam po 'khyil ba/ nub byang du mdzes ma dang gdong gi dbang po/ byang shar du dbyangs can ma dang spyod pa'i dbang po/ thams cad kyang sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dar gyi na bza' can/ mo rnams kyi phyag g.yas pas shing thog bī dza pū ra ka dang bcas pa'i mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya can/ g.yon pa rnams kyis 'bras kyi snye ma thugs kar 'dzin pa/ bud med sgyu ma'i nga rgyal gyis 'gyings pa/ rin po che 'bar ba skyugs par gyur pa'i padma'i gter la sogs pa'i steng du skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa'i brla g.yon pa rnams kyi steng du/ pho rnams rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i phyag g.yas pa rnams shing tog bī dza pū ra ka 'dzin pas mo rnams kyi g.yon nas mgul par 'khyud pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyis ne'u le 'dzin pa'o// lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi snying ga'i baṃ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal mo nor rgyun ma la nor lha'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs pa la/ oṃ shrī bā su dhā ri ṇi maṇḍa la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ badzra padyāṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ nas/ shabda āḥhūm̐ gi bar sbyar bas mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa mdun bskyed la gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra sbyar ba'i arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di rnams la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/

zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las thams cad la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan/ mchod pa bsang sbyang byin gyis brlabs nas/ thal mo sbyar te/ 'jig rten 'di 'am dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams// 'phags ma 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzod// oṃ shrī bā su dhā ri ṇi maṇḍa la sa pa ri wā ra badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang*/ de bzhin du/ zhabs bsil dang padyāṃ/ me tog dang puṣpe/ bdug yos dang dhū pe/ mar me dang ā lo ke /dri chab dang ghandhe/ zhal zas dang nai bidyā/ rol mo dang shabda 'i bar 'don pa bsgyur la 'bul zhing*/ oṃ badzra dharmā ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba buddha kṣe tra pra tsā li ni pra dzñā pā ra mi ta nā da saṃ bha ba/ badzra dharmā hṛ da ya santo ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho ā khaṃ swā hā/ zhes brjod/ spro na/ rtsibs stong ldan pa'i gser gyi 'khor lo sogs// rgya chen bsod nams dpal las legs grub pa// mi yi dbang po'i rin chen sna bdun 'bul// bzhes nas dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol// oṃ shrī bā su dhā ri ṇi maṇḍa la sa pa ri wā ra sapta ratna pū dzi te hūm̐/ g.yul las rgyal bar byed pa'i ral gri sogs// bsod nams du ma'i mthu yis legs bskyed pa'i// sa bdag nye ba'i rin chen sna bdun 'bul// bzhes nas dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol// oṃ shrī bā su dhā ri ṇi maṇḍa la sa pa ri wā ra sapta u pa ratna pū dzi te hūm̐: yid 'ong gzugs dang rnar snyan sgra la sogs// bsod nams du ma'i mthu yis legs bskyed pa'i// mtho ris 'gro ba'i 'dod yon rnam lnga 'bul// bzhes nas dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol// oṃ shrī bā su dhā ri ṇi maṇḍa la sa pa ri wā ra pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te hūm̐/

thub pas byin brlabs me long sogs dang ni// sku yi cha shas dbyibs mtshon dpal be'u sogs// bkra shis sgrub pa'i rdzas dang rtags brgyad 'bul// bzhes nas dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol// oṃ shrī bā su dhā ri ṇi maṇḍa la sa pa ri wā ra maṅga la aṣṭa dra bya tsihṇa pū dzi te hūm̐/ zhes pa'i sngags rnams la nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bya zhing mchod/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ phun tshogs dge legs kun 'byung bcom ldan ma// dpal dang 'byor pa'i dbang phyug nor rgyun ma// yid la re ba'i bkra shis stsol mdzad ma// bsam 'phel dkyil 'khor dbang phyug ma la 'dud// gang sngon sbyin pa rgya mtsho'i dge bsags pas// tshe dang nor dang mthu yi dpal brnyes nas// sgrub pa po la dbyig gi char 'beb pa'i// nor sbyin yab yum 'khor dang bcas la bstod// ces bstod/ gtor ma chu gtsang mas sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis brlab/ sngags rnams kyi mthar/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba siddhi mme pra yatstshantu hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces lan gsum sogs kyis phul/ oṃ shrī bā su dhā ri ṇi maṇḍa la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā sogs nas/ shabda 'i bar sbyar bas mchod/ phun tshogs dge legs kun 'byung sogs kyis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor dang bcas pas bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag pos gtsor byas sems can thams cad la 'dod rgu'i 'byor pa'i dngos grub zad mi shes pa bstsal du gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol/ gzungs thag nas gzung ste/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer sngags phreng gi rnam pa can 'phros pas lha rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de rnams kyi sku las 'od zer pho nya lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab/ sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang 'phags pa'i tshogs kyi byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer ser po'i rnam par spyan drangs shing*/

de dang dus mnyam du srid pa gsum gyi dpal 'byor longs spyod bcud g.yang dang bcas pa thams cad bkrag mdangs gzi brjid can gyi rnam par bkug ste/ bum pa'i nang gi rdzas rnams la gnyis su med par thim pas 'dod rgu'i dpal 'byor zad mi shes pa'i gter gyi bum pa bzang por gyur/ bum pa'i nang gi dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa rab tu 'phel zhing kha nas lhud kyis lud/ lha rnams kyi sku dang phyag mtshan rnams las kyang rin po che dang 'bras sogs mkho dgu longs spyod kyi char chen po chil chil babs pas/ gnas khang dang gtsug lag khang dang bang mdzod la sogs pa mer gyis khengs pas bdag dang sbyin bdag gi mtshon pa'i sems can thams cad bsam pa rdzogs par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam la/ oṃ bā su dhā ri ṇyai swā hā/ zhes gtso bor bzla/ thun mtshams rnams su 'khor rnams la/ oṃ tsand+ra kānt+yai swā hā/ de bzhin du/ oṃ dā tā yai swā hā/ oṃ su dā tā yai swā hā/ oṃ ārya yai swā hā/ oṃ su bha dra yai swā hā/ oṃ gupta yai swā hā/ oṃ de byāai swā hā/ oṃ swa ra swa tyāai swā hā/ zhes pas yum rnams dang*/ oṃ dzambha la dza lend+ra ya swā hā/ de bzhin du/ oṃ ma ṇi bha dra ya swā hā/ oṃ pūrṇa bha dra ya swā hā/ oṃ dha naṃ dā ya swā hā/ oṃ bai shra ba ṇā ya swā hā/ oṃ ki li mā li nī swā hā/ oṃ pi tsi kuṇḍa lī nī swā hā/ oṃ mu khend+ra ya swā hā/ oṃ tsaryend+ra ya swā hā/ zhes pa yab rnams te so sor gtso mo'i bcu cha re bzla/ thun bsdu ba na/ mchod pa bsang sbyang byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ shrī bā su dhā ri ṇi sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā nas/ shabda 'i bar sbyar bas mchod/ phun tshogs dge legs sogs kyis bstod/ yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid bstsal gang// de yang bzod par mdzad du gsol//

zhes bzod par gsol/ de nas me tog ser po thogs la/ bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma nor rgyun ma'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams rten 'di rnams la brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas rten 'di rnams gang du bzhugs pa'i yul phyogs dang gnas khang thams cad du lo phyugs rtag tu legs shing 'bru bcud dar ba dang*/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thams cad rgya mtsho chen po la chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du 'du bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes dang*/ su pra tiṣṭha dang*/ ye dharmā mang du brjod cing me tog 'thor ro// de lta bu'i gsol gdab brtan bzhugs lan gsum mam bdun la sogs pa gang mang bya/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rnams kyis mtshan par gyur/ ces gnas gsum bsrung*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /nor rgyun dpal mo 'grub gyur nas// sogs dang*/ thams cad nam mkha'i mdzod bzhin du// longs spyod zad pa med par shog /rtsod pa med cing 'tshe med pa// rang dbang du ni spyod par shog /lha yang dus su char 'bebs shing*// lo tog phun sum tshogs par shog /rgyal po chos bzhin byed pa dang*// 'jig rten dag kyang dar bar shog /'bad dang rtsol bas ma gos pa// yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam bzhin// sems can re ba skong mdzad pa// bsam pa 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog / ces sogs bsngo smon shis brjod khyad par ba dang*/ gzhan yang*/ che ba'i che mchog sogs mdo rgyud nas 'byung ba'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa rgya cher brjod/ de lta bu thun du bcad nas rang ngam sbyin bdag la rmi ltas dge ba lta bu'i rtags ma byung gi bar ram zhag bdun sogs bsgrub bo// gsum pa rjes ni/ de ltar legs par bsgrubs pa'i mthar bang mdzod kyi phugs/ phyugs lhas kyi gong*/ zhing sa bzang po'i dkyil sogs gang du 'jog pa'i sar spyan drangs te sgrom bu'i nang du padma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i steng du zhal phyi sgo dang*/

lung pa'i mda' sogs dang mi 'phrod par byas te mchod pa'i bye brag dang bcas te bzhag /brtan bzhugs dang shis brjod rgyas par bya/ dus dang dus su me tog sogs nyer spyod dang*/ zas sna'i phud sogs kyis mchod na 'dod rgu'i dngos grub nges par ster bar 'gyur la/ gal te sngags bsgrubs nas yun ring song ba yin na bzhag dus zhal gso ba'i don du sngar bshad pa ltar gyi cho ga tshar gcig bskyar na'ang legs par 'gyur ro// tshul 'di rje e waṃ pa dkon mchog dpal ldan sogs kyis gsang 'dus kyi phyogs su gtogs par mdzad pa'ang*/ cho ga'i yan lag rnams bla med ltar bkral ba'i dbang du byas na 'gal ba med mod/ 'on kyang gzhi'i rgyud 'jam dpal dpa' bo grub pa ni rgyud sde 'og ma yin pas/ cho ga spyi khyab tsam la'ang brten du rung bas/ de ltar na mchod pa bsang sngags sogs a mṛta sa bya ba dang*/ rol mo byin gyis brlabs pa'i sngags dharmā ra ṇi brjod pa tsam khyad par ro// gang ltar yang khrus dang gtsang sbra sogs kun spyod ni rgyud sde 'og ma ltar bya ba gal che'o// gnod sbyin 'khor lo la brten nas// 'dod rgu'i mchog stsol gter chen po'i// bum bzang sgrub thabs bgyis pa'i dges// srid zhi'i dge mtshan rgyas gyur cig /ces pa'ang 'jam mgon bla ma ngag gi dbang pos mdzad pa'i yig cha lung rgyun ma bzhugs pa'i stabs kyis/ gsung rab de nyid kyi dgongs don ltar bya bral ba mañdzu gho ṣas bklag chog tu dag par bris pa dge legs mchog tu gyur cig /sarba dā ka lyā ṇaṃ bha ba tu/// / 'di ni 'jam mgon rin po che dang rigs bdag bla ma rnams kyi dgongs rdzogs phyir du kha bskangs te spar gsar du bsgrubs pa yin pas dbang lung sogs la zhib cha bya dgos pa yod do// zhes si tu padma dbang mchog rgyal po kho bos ched du gdams pa'o/// / 'di gter byon khongs gtogs min 'dug kyang dpal spungs si tu padma dbang mchog rin po ches shin tu nyer mkhos sngar bzhag mdzad par mos mthun gyis rang sor bzhag par byas/
bal yul zhe dgon dpe bskrun pas so//
